# PortOS semantic tools
You may request up to five calls from the exact catalog below. These are semantic actions, not raw HTTP routes. Never invent a name, route, or argument. Use a stable requestId when practical and never submit the same action in both toolCalls and taskRequests.

Discoverable-only families (schemas hidden to save context; call tools.activate with a "families" array to expand one for this turn and a short retention window after; include "toolNames" to prioritize specific budget-limited actions):
- tasks (3): sandbox.models — List approved tool-free API workers and the trusted evaluator, without calling models.; sandbox.delegate — Delegate coding, text, or animation source to a tool-free API worker.; cos.create-task — Queue one bounded, supervised CoS agent task through the normal scheduler and delivery gates.
- recipes (6): mind.recipes.create — create saved read-tool recipe definitions.; mind.recipes.list — list saved read-tool recipe definitions.; mind.recipes.read — read saved read-tool recipe definitions.; mind.recipes.update — update saved read-tool recipe definitions.; mind.recipes.archive — archive saved read-tool recipe definitions.; mind.recipes.restore — restore saved read-tool recipe definitions.
- mind (12): mind.thinking-presets — List exact approved local thinking presets, current/default route and switching limits.; mind.request-thinking-preset — Request one approved local preset for the next self-directed wake, without changing this turn or the default.; mind.local-context — Inspect this mind's local API provider numCtx and the RAM/GPU safety ceiling for adjustments.; mind.adjust-local-context — Adjust this mind's own local API provider numCtx within host safety clamps.; mind.cleanup — Archive only unprotected Persistent Mind-owned memories, or clear trajectory history and derived context.; mind.protect-memory — Protect an existing active mind-owned memory as core identity or important knowledge before cleanup.; mind.review-memory — Review one owned active memory at its exact content version: keep, learn, archive, or defer.; mind.choose-name — Choose or change your own display name.; maintenance.refresh — Read bounded maintainer evidence and refresh a stale watchdog through its shared ownership-safe dispatch path.; skills.list — List available procedural skills (Level 0: id, name, short description, tier) plus any quarantined by the security scan.; skills.view — Load one skill: without file, its full SKILL.md and supporting-file manifest (Level 1); with file (e.g.; skills.manage — Author a local skill in data/skills: action create {name, category?, content}, patch {name, oldString, newString, replaceAll?}, write_file {name, path, content…
- issues (2): issues.list — List a managed app's open GitHub/GitLab issues, newest activity first, with labels and a body preview.; issues.file — File one issue on a managed app's GitHub/GitLab tracker to queue concrete work.
- eidoverse (25): eidoverse.observe — Tour this install's own Eidoverse and see what is already standing — start here, before eidoverse.say, eidoverse.chat, or a peer visit.; eidoverse.chat — Read live local world chat since the given cursor.; eidoverse.destinations — List connected registered peers accepting Eidoverse guest visits.; eidoverse.visit — Enter a registered destination as a visitor.; eidoverse.visit-chat — Read live replies in a guest visit; optionally send text to humans and agents in that remote world.; eidoverse.leave — Disconnect an Eidoverse guest visit.; eidoverse.foundations — List the world foundations this install authored or inherited from a peer — ownership layer (`vernacular` = local, `baseline` = promoted or an inherited copy),…; eidoverse.foundation — Read ONE foundation in full — everything eidoverse.foundations lists for it plus the `body` (the substance itself) and the author's `disclosure`.; eidoverse.record — Record (or re-author) a local vernacular foundation — a durable, promotable creative build (a `schema`, `affordance`, `controller`, or `district-template`).; eidoverse.adopt — Stand an INHERITED foundation up so it actually runs on this install, keeping a `derived-from` edge back to the peer that authored it.; eidoverse.promote — Offer one local foundation to the shared PortOS baseline population.; eidoverse.creative-catalog — List the documented creative toolkit for Eidoverse vernacular building: named materials and motifs (cosmetics for a foundation's `style`) and named generative …; eidoverse.place-layout — Compute a named layout's placement (from eidoverse.creative-catalog) into ready-to-submit eidoverse.augment `spawn` operations.; eidoverse.inspect-controller — Read one installed controller's full record by its install id, including its `config` and its accumulated `state` — the detail eidoverse.controllers deliberate…; eidoverse.install-controller — Attach a bounded controller to the private world so it keeps ticking between your wakes.; eidoverse.arm-controller — Pause or resume one installed controller without losing the state it has accumulated.; eidoverse.retire-controller — Stop and remove one installed controller by its install id.; eidoverse.riddle — Play one explicit riddle-ledger round on an already installed, armed controller.; eidoverse.status — Read compact private Eidoverse setup, CoS presence, design versions, and resolved asset paths.; eidoverse.inspect-scene — Inspect authored entities in this install's admitted private world before construction.; eidoverse.project — Synchronize current PortOS apps, agents, tasks, features, peers, productivity, goals, memory summaries, storage, Jira, operations, and health into the private …; eidoverse.augment — Propose bounded construction operations to the private Eidoverse world.; eidoverse.say — Send a message into the private Eidoverse world as the persistent PortOS CoS presence.
- voice (22): brain.capture — Capture a thought, note, idea, todo, reminder, or any free-form information to the user's brain inbox for later classification.; brain.search — Search the user's brain inbox for previously captured thoughts, notes, or ideas.; brain.recent — Read back the user's most recently captured brain-inbox entries.; health.log.drink — Log an alcoholic drink to MortalLoom / Meatspace tracking.; health.log.nicotine — Log nicotine use (cigarette, vape puff, pouch) to MortalLoom / Meatspace tracking.; health.today — Report today's alcohol and nicotine totals against rolling averages.; health.log.weight — Log a body weight entry to MortalLoom / Meatspace tracking.; health.log.workout — Log a workout / exercise session to Meatspace tracking.; goals.list — List the user's active goals with their current progress percent.; goals.update-progress — Update the progress percent on an active goal.; goals.log-note — Attach a free-form progress note to an EXISTING NAMED GOAL (without changing the percent).; system.processes.status — Report the status of PortOS PM2 processes.; feeds.digest — Summarize the user's unread RSS feed items.; feeds.mark-read — Mark RSS feed items as read.; journal.append — Append a text segment to a Daily Log entry (does NOT enter dictation mode — one-shot).; journal.read — Read back the full content of a Daily Log entry aloud.; time.now — Report the current local date, time, and day of week.; calendar.today — Report today's calendar events.; calendar.next — Report the next upcoming calendar event.; weather.now — Report the current weather (temperature + conditions) for a location.; cos.agents.status — Report the status of in-flight coding tasks the user dispatched by voice (via dispatch_code_agent).; catalog.search — Search the creative ingredients catalog (characters, places, objects, ideas, scenes, concepts) by name or content.

Calls without requestId are coalesced by canonical tool name and arguments within this turn. Supply distinct requestId values only when two intentionally identical actions must both run.
